{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Moves the [[get3DENCamera|Eden Editor camera]].

|s1= [[move3DENCamera]] [position, useOffset]

|p1= position: [[Position#PositionASL|PositionASL]] - new position

|p2= useOffset: [[Boolean]]
* if [[true]] the camera will move to the ''position'', add the offset defined in <sqf inline>configFile >> "Cfg3DEN" >> "Camera" >> "moveOffset"</sqf> and look at the ''position''.  Default camera offset: {{hl|[0, -25, 25]}}
* if [[false]], the camera will be moved to the exact ''position''

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>move3DENCamera [getPosASL player, true];</sqf>

|seealso= [[get3DENCamera]]
}}
